description: This Java source file defines the 'Device' class, representing an authenticated device client with methods for handling JWT tokens, authorities, and device identification within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents an authenticated device with identity and authorities, capable of verifying authorities and providing device information.

methods.name: Device(Jws<Claims> token)
methods.description: Constructs a Device object from a JWT token, extracting tenant, device ID, and authorities.

methods.name: Device(String tenantId, String deviceId)
methods.description: Constructs a Device object from tenant and device identifiers.

methods.name: getPrincipal(String tenantId, String deviceId)
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing the device's principal data.

methods.name: checkAuthorization(String authority)
methods.description: Checks if the device has a specific authority.

methods.name: principal()
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the device's principal.

methods.name: getTenantId()
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the device.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the device ID as the principal's name.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the device.

methods.name: asAddress(String tenantId, String deviceId)
methods.description: Creates an address string from tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: asAddress(Device device)
methods.description: Creates an address string from a Device object.
